Definition: Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Gihon = "bursting forth"; 1) one of the four rivers of the Garden of Eden; 2) a spring near Jerusalem where the anointing and proclaiming of Solomon as king took place
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
